targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as total FROM tenant_users WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true);
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM clients WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true);
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM loans WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true);

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as "Novos Clientes"
FROM clients
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as "Novos Empréstimos"
FROM loans
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total
FROM installments
WHERE status != 'paid'
  AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total
FROM installments
WHERE status != 'paid'
  AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true);

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) as "Pagas",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 'paid' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) as "Vencidas",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 'paid' AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) as "Pendentes"
FROM installments
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as "Logins"
FROM login_audit
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND success = true
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as "Logins Falhos"
FROM login_audit
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND success = false
  AND tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE ativo = true)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database()
  AND state = 'active';

SELECT
  t.name as tenant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as "Clientes",
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) as "Empréstimos",
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) as "Parcelas",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'paid' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Valor Pago",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status != 'paid' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Valor Vencido"
FROM tenants t
LEFT JOIN clients c ON t.id = c.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN loans l ON t.id = l.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN installments i ON l.id = i.loan_id
WHERE t.ativo = true
GROUP BY t.id, t.name
ORDER BY "Clientes" DESC
LIMIT 10;
